requests.body: Apply the same two fixes again and commit them before anything else: (1) in checks.dropped_eval_cases, record a dot-prefixed rename destination only as the dropped source case, never as a case of its own (test_dropped_test_files_and_eval_cases_pure); (2) add "ratchets" to the expected check set in test_gate_continues_on_a_clean_change (tests/test_gate.py:540). Then run the gate. In CI the gate's commands run on the runner after the session, outside the sandbox (SDLC_GATE_COMMANDS=runner), so the .env read denial inside the session does not affect the gate. Do not stop to ask; this round is unattended.
